#Question 1

```{r}
bdays = sample(1:365, 25, replace = TRUE)

length(unique(bdays)) < 25
```

```{r}
bday = function(n) {
  if (!is.numeric(n)) {
    stop("n must be numerical")
  } else if (length(n) !=1) {
    stop("n is a single number")
  } else if (n<2) {
    stop("group has more than 2 ppl")
  }
  
  bdays = sample (1:365, n, replace = TRUE)
  
  any(duplicated(bdays))
}

bday(10)
bday(50)
```
